preconditions.description: The length of the paths n must be between 2 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(path1) == n - 1 and all(c in 'NESW' for c in path1)
preconditions.description: The first grid path must be a string of length n-1 consisting of 'N', 'E', 'S', or 'W'.

preconditions.expression: len(path2) == n - 1 and all(c in 'NESW' for c in path2)
preconditions.description: The second grid path must be a string of length n-1 consisting of 'N', 'E', 'S', or 'W'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if can_reach_end(path1, path2) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if both marbles can reach the end of their respective paths, otherwise 'NO'.
